title: Book Three · Chapter 189: Anna's Answer
story:
During the twelfth working week, Anna's decision arrives.

She brings the letter to Ronan after his Friday work. He has received thirty more yuan. His work envelope now holds four hundred and twenty-nine.

Anna stands inside the green door with the page in both hands.

“Read the first part,” she says.

It offers her a place in the two-year building-design course.

Ronan looks up at her. She is trying to smile and speak at the same time.

“You have it.”

She nods. He puts his bag down and takes her in his arms.

For a moment, neither says anything. Then she laughs against his shoulder.

“I can breathe,” she says.

He moves back a little, smiling too.

They sit near the window and read the full letter. There are four teaching terms across the two years. The present class and shared-room fees stay two hundred and forty plus ninety for each term.

Her signed answer must arrive by the second Friday in May. No fee is needed with that reply. The first term's class and room money will be due before lessons begin.

“My mum and I read the costs,” Anna says.

Her parents have saved from their work for years. Their study fund can cover the class and room fees for all four terms. Food, materials, and travel have their own lines in the family budget.

They still need to check the detailed supply list. Anna has written those questions beside the letter.

“You want to say yes?” Ronan asks.

“Yes.”

He nods. She puts her hand over his.

“You too?”

“Yes.”

The two letters lie beside each other. The city names are different. Each letter offers a place.

Mum comes to the door after a customer leaves. Anna shows her the first line. Mum smiles and takes her hand for a moment.

“Your drawings,” she says.

Anna nods again and holds the letter closer. She reads her name once more.

“And a lot of changed lines.”

Ronan laughs softly. He brings water while Mum asks about the model room from the visit.

Mum pulls the spare chair nearer.

“Did you show them the little shop too?”

“Yes. That was one of the four copies.”

Ronan remembers the fruit shop in the drawing. Anna drew the space above it as carefully as the doorway.

“I liked the fruit,” he says.

Anna looks at him. “The whole building, and you remember the fruit?”

“There was a lot of it.”

“I changed the stairs three times.”

“I remember those too.”

Mum laughs and gives Anna the cup. Anna puts her letter beside Ronan's before she drinks.

For a little while, nobody asks about the next form or the next date. Mum tells Anna about a woman who wants a deeper pocket in her coat. Anna asks how deep. Mum puts her hand beside the cup to show her.

Ronan rests his arm on the table. He can listen without looking at the clock. His working day is over, and Anna is still smiling.

Anna starts with the roof. Ronan sits beside her and listens, with his own offer still near her elbow.

Later, they walk to the corner together. Before she takes her road, Anna gives him a quick kiss.

“Both of us,” she says.

He touches her hand. “Two places.”

She nods, and they stay close for one more moment before she goes.
studyGuide:
## 词句提示

building design＝建筑设计；detailed＝详细的；supply list＝所需物品清单；cover＝支付、足以承担。

## 理解问题

1. Anna真正拿到什么机会？确认期限、四学期及每学期费用怎样？
2. 她的家庭怎样为学习准备，是否要用Ronan的钱或等他改变方向？

## 读句子

**Each letter offers a place.**

拆开看：Each letter / offers / a place.

每一封来信／都正式提供了／一个学习名额。
